title: [main] Bug 656172 Payment Slips Summarized by Due Date are not aggregating correlative in the French version.
summary: The French Suggest Cust. Payments and Suggest Vend. Payments reports now aggregate non-consecutive invoices and credit memos correctly into summarized payment slips. The buffer lookup now matches on customer and currency, plus due date when summarizing by due date, instead of the full primary key.
key_points: Summarized payment lines now group by customer and currency, adding due date when summarizing by due date
The old Find() matched the full primary key, which included leftover Payment Line No. and Applies-to ID values from the previous group
When a matching group is found, Amount and Amount (LCY) are added and the group's line number, document number and application ID are kept
Applies to both the customer and vendor suggest payments reports, with new tests
quote: Payment Slips Summarized by Due Date are not aggregating Credit Memos and Invoices correctly if they are not correlative in the French version.
